privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1_text: The Data Controller of this website is identified in the Legal Notice section. You can consult the full owner identity directly at:
privacy.p2_text: Bingo Gamer follows a strict local-first architecture. All your bingo cards, custom images, logos, visual preferences (dark/light mode), and language settings are stored exclusively in your browser using IndexedDB and localStorage. We do not collect, transmit, or store personal data on our servers.
privacy.p3_text: The following third parties may process limited data as part of the service infrastructure: (1) Vercel Inc. — hosting provider that processes IP addresses for security and content delivery under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF). (2) Lemon Squeezy — payment processor for voluntary donations, which processes payment data under its own privacy policy and PCI DSS compliance. This website does NOT collect, store, or have access to any payment card information at any time.
privacy.p4_text: Vercel Inc. and Lemon Squeezy are US-based companies. Both operate under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) and/or Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), ensuring an adequate level of data protection as required by GDPR.
privacy.p5_text: Under the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679), you have the right to Access, Rectification, Suppression, Limitation, Portability, and Opposition (ARSULIPO) regarding your personal data. Since all user data is stored locally in your browser, you exercise these rights directly by clearing your browser's site data. For any request related to data processed by third parties (Vercel, Lemon Squeezy), please contact the owner via the email in the Legal Identity.
privacy.p6_text: Data stored locally in your browser persists until you manually clear it. Server-side logs (IP addresses processed by Vercel) are retained according to Vercel's data retention policy (typically up to 30 days).

cookies.title: Cookie and Storage Policy
cookies.p1_title: 1. What Are Cookies and Equivalent Technologies?
cookies.p1_text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. Under AEPD (Spanish Data Protection Agency) guidelines, equivalent technologies such as localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB receive the same legal treatment.
cookies.p2_text: Bingo Gamer uses exclusively technical/strictly necessary storage mechanisms for the application to function correctly. No tracking, advertising, or analytics cookies or scripts are used.
cookies.p3_text: localStorage: stores theme preference (dark/light), language selection, cookie consent acknowledgment, and support toast dismissal state. IndexedDB (via 'idb' library): stores bingo card configurations, custom event logos (as Base64/Blobs), and cell background images. All data remains exclusively on the user's device.
cookies.p4_text: In accordance with Article 22.2 of the LSSI-CE (Ley 34/2002) and the AEPD guidelines on cookies, this website is exempt from obtaining prior consent for the use of cookies or equivalent storage technologies, as it exclusively uses those that are strictly necessary for the provision of the service expressly requested by the user. No interactive consent panel is required.
cookies.p5_text: You can delete all stored data at any time through your browser's settings (Clear Site Data) or by using the in-app clear features. This will reset your bingo cards, preferences, and visual customizations.
